thesis: VTRS is in a strong uptrend above its 20, 50 and 200-day averages with +36% 63-day relative strength, and it is trading near a 52-week high after an EPS beat and a held guide. The stock is extended, so the case is a pullback entry at 20.35-20.80 with a defined stop, not a chase. Reward/risk of about 2.1 is acceptable but the edge is modest.
